name: Minerva
source:
Max, Isa, and Cole enter a Montana forest for a three day camping trip. Max struggles to manage Cole and Isa's butting heads while also taking notice of the bizarre events unfolding around them. Mystery and questions quickly creep in, and soon the seed of doubt is planted. Unable to escape the forest, they must face the monster within in head first.
